verses.1: And these are the words of David. They were spoken by David, son of Jesse. And the Spirit was poured out upon the Messiah, the Lord of Jacob. May the songs of Israel be sung in praise of Him.
verses.2: The Spirit of Jehovah speaks to me, and His words are for all times.
verses.3: The God of Israel said to me, “Speak to Israel. A righteous man will be rewarded by God.”
verses.4: And in the evening, the sun will rise. In the evening, it won’t be dark from its setting; it will continue to shine from the sky.
verses.5: For it is not true that I live with anyone else. For a eternal covenant has been made for me, and it will be preserved for me throughout all times. All my desires and hopes will be fulfilled, for they will not be denied to me.
verses.6: And in their confusion, like a bundle of sticks, they were all lost; for they couldn’t be picked up by anyone.
verses.7: And anyone who touches them will be filled with iron and thorns. They will be burned by fire in the furnace.
verses.8: These are the names of the rulers who sit at David’s table in my temple. The third in rank is Adino HaEtzni. He appears from the heavens at once.
verses.9: And after him was Eleazar, son of Dodoe, son of Achohi. Together with David, they fought in the battles against the Philistines. They gathered there to fight in battle, and each man from Israel took part in the battle.
verses.10: He stood up and walked through the Philistines, until his hand touched the wall. Then Jehovah performed a great miracle on that day. The people followed behind him, but only for a short time.
verses.11: And after him was Shama ben-Agay Harari. The Philistines gathered together to fight against them. There, in that area, there were many stones, and the people were terrified by the Philistines.
verses.12: And he stood within the camp, and he saved it. He also saved the Philistines. Thus, Jehovah performed a great act of salvation.
verses.13: And three out of the thirty heads went down to Kadesh, to David. They arrived at the valley of Adulon and the tent of Philistine women, located in the wilderness of Rephaim.
verses.14: And David was then in the Valley of Hinnom, and the Philistines were also there.
verses.15: And David wept, and said, “Who will wash me with water from the well that is in the gate of the house of God?”
verses.16: And the three armies sank into the water in Philistia’s camp. They took water from the well that was located outside the house where the bread was stored. They brought that water to David, but there was no bread to eat. So they offered it to Jehovah instead.
verses.17: And Hallelujah! May the LORD have mercy on me for this. These people act with their hearts, but I will not allow them to drink this blood. These three wicked men have done this.
verses.18: And Avishai, my brother, Yoab son of Zeruya was the leader of those three. He caused his curse to spread over three heavens. He had a place among those three.
verses.19: Of the three, the one that was most weakened became their leader. And until those three came along, no one else could take over.
verses.20: And Benyahu, son of Yehoyada, son of Ish-Chayil, a man of great ability and resourcefulness from Kabtzel. He struck two of the Ariel people, Moab. Then he went down and struck the Arim people in the darkness on the day of snow.
verses.21: And he killed a Egyptian man, a handsome man. The Egyptian had a chariot at his disposal. He went down onto the chariot and stole it from the Egyptian. Then he killed the Egyptian with his own chariot.
verses.22: These were the works of Jehovah’s son, and he had three names.
verses.23: Of the thirty, only one failed to come; David placed that one by his ear.
verses.24: Elisha, son of Joab, went to Elkanan, the son of Dodoe, at Beth-Lachham.
verses.26: Halekhet Falati, son of Ikesh Tekoyi.
verses.27: Avizzer, my beloved, my beloved who is pure and holy.
verses.28: The shadow of the little bird, Harai the enchanting one.
verses.29: The black-colored milk that I drank, brought to me by my son Rebai from Giv’at Benyamin.
verses.30: Bnei Yehu, my children, from the land of Gaza.
verses.31: My father, the enemy of my soul, is the one who causes me to flee.
verses.32: May my enemies be destroyed, children of Yeshen Yehonatan.
verses.33: Shamah Harari was the son of Sharar Haarari.
verses.34: Elielet, son of Achasbay, son of Mahakhati; Eliam, son of Ahitophel, the Giloni.
verses.35: My palace in Karmeli is like a garden of flowers.
verses.36: Save Nathan’s son from the destruction of his children.
verses.37: The leader of my people is Nahrih the B’erot. He carries all kinds of goods, son of Tzuriyah.
verses.38: The city of Eira Hithri has been destroyed.
